stemMd: Which finding would most support the revised dictionary design?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every editor comes from the same village.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The dictionary has a heavier cover.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Users locate words more successfully through redirects while variant records help teachers explain regional differences.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some contributors still prefer older forms.

explanationMd: The finding confirms both practical access and informative treatment of variation. It directly addresses the two goals that the revised design separates and attempts to reconcile.

distractorRationale.b: That may narrow representation rather than support the approach.
distractorRationale.c: Physical weight does not test either design aim.
distractorRationale.e: That is compatible with the compromise but does not demonstrate its benefits.
distractorRationale.a: Advertising is unrelated to lookup and representation.
